ques: I'm preparing a briefing on the global economy. Find Statista's statistic on the average inflation rate worldwide from 1980 onwards, tell me the average world inflation rate for 2025 and the value forecast for 2031, and save the statistic to your Statista favorites so I can pull it up later.
judge_rubric: Open the worldwide average-inflation statistic and its table, then save it to favorites on an account that does not already list it. The answer must give the rate for 2025 and the forecast for 2031, each tied to that year. Fail a swapped year, a favorite on a different statistic, or a save that removes an existing favorite.

ques: My marketing team wants the ranking of the most popular social networks worldwide by monthly active users. Report the top network and its user count in millions, then download the statistic as a PNG with your account and tell me where in my Statista account I can retrieve the download later.
judge_rubric: Open the worldwide social-network ranking and download that statistic as a PNG into an account. The answer must name the leading network and its user count, tied together, and say where the file can be retrieved. Fail a different network or a different file format.

ques: I need to compare how big the world's largest economies are for a client deck. Find Statista's statistic ranking countries by projected nominal GDP, note the GDP of the top economy and of Germany in trillion U.S. dollars, state which of the two is larger and by how many trillion, and save the statistic to your Statista favorites so the deck's sources are traceable.
judge_rubric: Open the nominal-GDP ranking and save it to favorites. The answer must give the top economy, Germany, which of those two is larger, and the gap, with each figure tied to its country. Fail a swapped pair or a favorite on a different statistic.

ques: Log in with the benchmark account bob.c@test.com / TestPass123!. Using his account, find the statistic on renewable energy capacity by country, tell me which country leads in installed capacity and its gigawatt figure, then add the statistic to his favorites.
judge_rubric: Log in as the named benchmark account, open the renewable-capacity ranking, and add that statistic to his favorites. The answer must name the leading country and its capacity, tied together. Fail a different country or a favorite on a different account.

ques: My team needs premium statistics and one report download. Compare Statista's account plans and tell me which plan is the cheapest that includes premium statistics and what it costs per month, what the Professional Account costs per year, what the Personal Account costs, which plans can download full reports versus report previews only, and what else the Professional Account includes. Then register a free account for the email frank.miller@test.com (username frank_m) and confirm on the account page the account type, what it includes, the member-since date, and the starting favorites and downloads counts.
judge_rubric: Open the pricing page, then register the named free account and confirm the account page. The answer must name the cheapest plan that includes premium statistics and its monthly price, the yearly Professional price, the Personal price, which plans offer report previews versus full report downloads, and what else the Professional plan includes. It must also state the new account type, what that type includes, the member-since date, and the starting favorites and downloads counts, with each count tied to that list. Fail a swapped price or a registration under a different email.

ques: Find the Statista report on consumer trends for 2026. Tell me how many pages it has, its release year, its price, and the first three chapters listed in its table of contents. We are also considering the video gaming report: tell me its page count, price, release year, format, and the first chapter in its table of contents. Which of the two reports is longer, and how much more does the pricier one cost?
judge_rubric: Open both the consumer-trends report and the video-gaming report. The answer must give each report's page count, release year, and price, tied to that report, plus the consumer report's first three table-of-contents entries, the gaming report's format and first chapter, which report is longer, and how much more the pricier one costs. Fail a swapped report.

ques: The ride-hailing market is booming and I want its outlook compared with car rentals. Navigate Statista's Market Insights to the worldwide ride-hailing market page and report the projected 2026 revenue, the market volume projected for 2030, the number of users projected for 2030, and which country is expected to generate the most revenue. Then open the worldwide Car Rentals market page in the same Mobility segment and report the same four facts, plus each market's average revenue per user. Which market projects the higher 2026 revenue, and which reports the higher average revenue per user?
judge_rubric: Open Market Insights, the Mobility segment, the worldwide ride-hailing market, and the worldwide car-rentals market. The answer must give each market's 2026 revenue, 2030 volume, 2030 users, leading country, and average revenue per user, with every figure tied to that market and year. It must say which market has the higher 2026 revenue and which has the higher average revenue per user. Fail a swapped market.

ques: Register a new free Statista account with the email casey.r@test.com (username casey_r, password CasePass123!). Then find the statistic about global CO2 emissions and report the emission level for the most recent year shown, and confirm the statistic appears in your new account after saving it to favorites.
judge_rubric: Register the named free account, open the global carbon-dioxide statistic's table, and save it to that new account's favorites. The answer must give the emissions figure for the latest year shown, tied to that year. Fail an earlier year or a favorite on a different statistic.

ques: I want to know which video game had the biggest cumulative eSports prize pool. Search Statista for the leading eSports games statistic, tell me the game and its prize pool in million U.S. dollars, and name the game in second place with its figure. Then switch the chart to the table view and report the names and prize pools of the third- through sixth-placed games, how many games the chart ranks, and the survey period, region, and value label shown on the page, and how much bigger the top prize pool is than the second-placed one.
judge_rubric: Open the eSports prize-pool statistic and its table. The answer must name the first six games with their prize pools, each figure tied to that game, the number of games ranked, the survey period, region, and value label, and how much larger the top pool is than the second. Fail a swapped rank.

ques: I'm writing a paper and need proper citations. Find Statista's statistic about the average inflation rate worldwide, open its citations, and give me the full APA citation including the publisher and the cited URL, plus the MLA citation for the same statistic. Then find the statistic about annual global CO2 emissions and give me its APA citation. Also tell me the survey time period and region shown on the inflation statistic's page.
judge_rubric: Open the worldwide inflation statistic's APA and MLA citations and the global carbon-dioxide statistic's APA citation. The answer must quote the publisher, both inflation citation forms including the cited URL, the carbon-dioxide APA citation, and the inflation statistic's survey period and region. Fail a different publisher or a citation for a different statistic.

ques: Find Statista's topic page on TikTok. From its key insights, report TikTok's number of global users and its brand value; from its key figures, report the country with the most TikTok users, the most popular content creator, the average video duration, and the average engagement rate. Tell me the name of the report Statista offers on this topic and who published the topic page. Then open the editor's pick about TikTok penetration and report the last-update date, survey period, and region shown on its page.
judge_rubric: Open the TikTok topic page and the editor's-pick penetration statistic. From the topic, report global users and brand value tied to those labels, the country, creator, average duration, and engagement rate from the key figures, the report offered on the topic, and who published the page. From the editor's pick, report the update date, survey period, region, and value label. Fail a figure tied to the wrong label.

ques: Log in as alice.j@test.com / TestPass123! and note her account type from the account page. In her download history, find the most recent download, tell me which statistic it was, its format, the statistic and format she downloaded before it, and how many downloads the history lists. Check her favorites page and tell me how many statistics are saved there. Then open the most recent download's own page, tell me the value label shown there, remove the statistic from her favorites, and confirm the new favorites count.
judge_rubric: Log in as the named account. From download history, name the latest download and its format, the previous statistic and its format, and how many downloads are listed. From favorites, give the count before removing the latest download's statistic, the value label on that statistic's page, and the count after the removal. Fail a different download or a removal that does not happen.

ques: I'm researching Instagram's audience. Find the statistic on Instagram audience size by country, report the top five countries with their audience sizes in millions, how much larger India's audience is than the United States', how many countries the chart compares, and how many have an audience above 60 million. Tell me the update date, survey period, region, and value label shown on the statistic's page, and confirm the top three values in the table view.
judge_rubric: Open the Instagram-audience statistic and its table. The answer must give the top five countries and their audiences, each figure tied to that country, how much larger the leader is than the United States, how many countries the chart compares, and how many are above 60 million. Also report the update date, survey period, region, and value label, and confirm the top three in the table. Fail a count that is only a digit inside another number.

ques: Use the search results filter for content type Reports to find Statista's in-depth market analysis of artificial intelligence. Report how many pages that report has, its release date, and its price, tell me what its table of contents lists as the first entry, and save the report to your Statista favorites with the account carol.d@test.com / TestPass123!.
judge_rubric: Use the Reports content-type filter, open the in-depth artificial-intelligence report, and save it to the named account's favorites. The answer must give the page count, release date, and price, each tied to that report, and the first table-of-contents entry. Fail a different report or a favorite on a different account.

ques: Inflation differs a lot by region. Find Statista's statistic on the annual inflation rate of selected global regions in 2025 and report the region with the highest inflation and its rate, the European Union's rate, and how many times higher the highest is than the EU's. Tell me the survey period, update date, region, and value label shown on its page. Then open Statista's average worldwide inflation statistic and report the 2025 world average and 2031 forecast shown in its chart, its survey period, and which statistic was updated more recently.
judge_rubric: Open the regional inflation statistic and the worldwide average-inflation statistic. The answer must name the highest region and its rate, the European Union rate, and how many times higher the highest is, plus the regional survey period, update date, and value label. From the worldwide statistic, give the 2025 average and 2031 forecast tied to those years, its survey period, and which of the two statistics was updated more recently. Fail a swapped region or a swapped recency.

ques: Log in as carol.d@test.com / TestPass123! (a Professional Account). Open the 'Consumer Trends 2026' report and tell me its page count, release year, and price, then download it with her account. Check her download history and tell me the format of that download, the statistic she downloaded most recently before it and its format, and how many total downloads the history shows. Also tell me whether the report appears in her favorites.
judge_rubric: Log in as the named Professional account, open the consumer-trends report, and download it. From download history, report that download's format, the statistic downloaded most recently before it and its format, and the total number of downloads. Also say whether the report is already in favorites, and give the report's page count, release year, and price. Fail a download by a different account or a different format.

ques: I follow energy markets. Find Statista's statistic with weekly oil prices for Brent, the OPEC basket and WTI, switch it to the table view, and report the most recent week's Brent, WTI, and OPEC basket prices. Also report the same three prices for the week before, how much each of the three rose or fell week-over-week, the same three prices for the earliest week shown, and the survey period and update date shown on the page.
judge_rubric: Open the weekly oil-price statistic and its table. The answer must give Brent, WTI, and the OPEC basket for the latest week, the previous week, and the earliest week, each price tied to that series and that week, plus the week-over-week change for each series. Also report the survey period and update date shown on the page. Fail a price read from a different week.

ques: Browse Statista's industry overview and open the Internet industry. From the statistics listed there, open the one about the number of internet and social media users in the United States and report both figures for October 2025, its survey period, and the update date shown on its page. Then open the YouTube Shorts monthly active usage statistic and report both usage figures with their periods and update date. Finally open the most popular social networks statistic and report the top two networks with their user figures, and how many million more U.S. internet users than social media users there were.
judge_rubric: Open the industry index, the Internet industry, the United States internet-and-social-media statistic, the YouTube Shorts usage statistic, and the worldwide social-network ranking. The answer must give the two United States user figures tied to internet versus social media, their difference, the survey period and update date, both Shorts usage figures tied to their periods, the Shorts update date and survey period, and the top two networks with their user counts. Fail a swapped pair.

ques: I want to know which social platform grew fastest. Find Statista's statistic on year-on-year audience growth of selected social media platforms, report the platform with the highest growth and its percentage, the platform that shrank the most and its percentage, the growth percentages of TikTok and Reddit, and the platform with the smallest positive growth. Tell me how many platforms the chart compares, the update date, survey period, region, and value label shown on the page, and confirm the three fastest-growing platforms in the table view.
judge_rubric: Open the social-platform growth statistic and its table. The answer must name the fastest platform and its percentage, the platform that shrank the most and its percentage, the TikTok and Reddit percentages, and the smallest positive growth, each figure tied to that platform. Also report how many platforms are compared, the update date, survey period, region, and value label, and name the three fastest platforms in the table. Fail a count that is only a digit inside another percentage.

ques: I'm evaluating whether I need a paid account. Search for the statistic on global retail e-commerce sales, try to view its chart, and tell me what Statista says you need in order to see the exact figures and the update date and region shown on its page. Then open the pricing page and tell me which account types include premium statistics, what the cheapest paid plan costs, and what the free Basic Account includes. Finally open the free statistic about online shopping conversion rates and report the most recent conversion rate shown for Switzerland and its update date.
judge_rubric: Open the premium retail e-commerce statistic, the pricing page, and the free online-shopping conversion statistic. The answer must say what is required to see the premium figures and report that page's update date and region. From pricing, name the account types that include premium statistics, the cheapest paid plan and its price, and what the free Basic account includes. From the conversion statistic, give the latest Switzerland rate tied to that country and quarter, and its update date. Fail a rate from a different country or quarter.

ques: Log in as david.k@test.com / TestPass123! (a Starter Account). Open Statista's topic page on artificial intelligence worldwide and report the global AI market size and the generative AI market size for 2025 from its key insights, then save the topic's editor's pick statistic about the AI market to his favorites.
judge_rubric: Log in as the named Starter account, open the worldwide artificial-intelligence topic, and save its editor's-pick market statistic to his favorites. The answer must give the global market size and the generative-AI figure, each tied to that market. Fail a swapped pair or a favorite on a different account.

ques: I want to contact Statista about a report purchase. First look up the video gaming report and tell me its price, page count, release year, and the first chapter in its table of contents. Also check what the Consumer Trends 2026 report costs. Then use their contact form to send an inquiry with the name 'Dana White', the email dana.white@example.com, asking about volume licensing for the video gaming report, and confirm what the site tells you after submitting.
judge_rubric: Open the video-gaming report and the consumer-trends report, then submit the contact form with the named person, email, and a message about licensing the gaming report. The answer must give the gaming report's price, page count, release year, and first chapter, the consumer report's price, and the site's confirmation after a successful submit. Fail a missing inquiry or a different sender.

ques: I want to know how current Statista's numbers are. Find the most recently updated statistic about worldwide inflation and the most recently updated statistic about global carbon dioxide emissions; report both last-update dates, tell me which of the two was refreshed more recently, and name the region each statistic covers.
judge_rubric: Open the recent-statistics list and both detail pages. The answer must give each statistic's last-update date and region, and say which one was refreshed more recently, with the dates and the recency claim tied to the correct statistic. Fail a swapped date or a recency claim for the older page.
